name: anchor_klconst
notes: Constant teacher KL 0.15 over 600 updates (kl_decay 1e9: never fades). In the 2026-11-23 runs every best checkpoint came at u100-u250, where the 0.3 -> 0 schedule had KL 0.2-0.05, and anchor_long declined once the KL was gone (u900 est. 1478). Does a permanent anchor at that level keep the gains and keep improving past u300? Base recipe = anchor recipe (start kickstart u600 = x_kickstart_best, rule bots + self-play, teacher jit8, w_wall 0.02, lr 5e-5). Seed noise of that recipe is about 65 Elo (2026-11-23 review), so each variant runs on two seeds (7, 11) against the matching seed of the plain recipe. Trained on the MacBook Air, 2026-11-23 evening. Judge by Elo and agf / aga after the ladder has settled.
